No type errors. The existing warnings are just about unused variables (the commented-out code), not related to our fix.

**Explanation:** `forEach` always returns `void` — it's meant for side effects, not transformations. To create a new array from an iterable, use `Array.from()` with `.map()`, or spread into an array first. Here I used `Array.from(formData.entries())` to get `[key, value]` pairs, then `.map()` to transform each into your `TestingElement` shape.
